title: Learning Beyond Rigid Manipulation with Hybrid Soft-Rigid Robots
abstract: arXiv:2410.07787v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Rigid-soft robot hybrids promise to unite the precision and repeatability of rigid manipulators with the compliance and adaptability of soft structures. Yet, full-fledged rigid-soft manipulators remain largely unexplored, in part because the intelligence required to exploit this combination is still missing. Here, we introduce a hybrid robotic system obtained by the series interconnection of a rigid arm and a soft manipulator, and systematically examine its ability to perform both established and previously inaccessible manipulation tasks. We show that a tailored imitation learning algorithm -- generally applicable to this class of hybrid systems -- leverages the complementary roles of rigid precision and soft embodiment to acquire manipulation skills and generalize them in a single shot across task variations. translated_title: 基于软-刚混合机器人学习超越刚性操作的能力
translated_abstract: 刚-软混合机器人有望将刚性机械臂的精度与可重复性和软体结构的柔顺性与适应性结合在一起。然而，成熟的刚-软混合机械臂在很大程度上仍未被充分探索，部分原因在于利用这种组合所需的智能仍然缺失。在此，我们介绍了一种由刚性机械臂与软体机械臂串联连接而成的混合机器人系统，并系统地考察了它执行既有操作任务以及此前无法完成的操作任务的能力。我们展示了一种量身定制的模仿学习算法——通常可适用于此类混合系统——利用刚性精度与软体本体的互补作用来习得操作技能，并在任务变化中实现单次泛化。因此，该系统在堆叠等经典任务中达到或超越了刚性机器人的性能，同时……
tldr: 该论文提出一种由刚性机械臂与软体机械臂串联构成的混合机器人系统，通过定制的模仿学习算法利用刚性精度与软体柔顺性的互补优势习得操作技能，并在任务变化中实现单次泛化，在堆叠等经典任务中达到甚至超越刚性机器人的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a hybrid robotic system with a rigid arm serially connected to a soft manipulator, showing that a tailored imitation learning algorithm exploits the complementary strengths of rigid precision and soft compliance to acquire manipulation skills that generalize in a single shot, matching or exceeding rigid robots in classical tasks such as stacking.
